name: Agent Office
description: Your harnesses and Swarms as little people in a pixel office, in 2.5D or 3D: who is typing, reading, browsing, who is waiting on you, and how each Swarm task is going. Click someone for their card and tasks, double-click to jump to them in Harness, or turn on Chat. Read only.
tagline: Your agents at work, as a pixel office
author: gray-seven

examples.prompt: Who is waiting on me, and what is everyone else doing?
examples.caption: Two computers, sixteen harnesses: reading, running commands, helpers on a hand-off.

examples.prompt: Show my Swarm in 3D at night.
examples.caption: A Swarm project: the coordinator's glass office, workgroups under their numbers.

examples.prompt: What is Ben working on right now?
examples.caption: Chat on: a click shows what a harness was asked and the reply it is writing.
